description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples for the install-pointer skill that the Copilot discovery plugin ships in .github/plugin/skills/ (a byte-identical copy of the Claude plugin's pointer, generated by condense.ts). Exemplars are the install, setup and upgrade asks the skill's description names, plus the question of why the plugin carries no other skills. Near-misses share vocabulary with an install and are somebody else's job: installing a different package, configuring an unrelated MCP server, and writing a skill. Counterexamples are ordinary coding work with no install intent.

queries.q: set up the event4u agent-config rules and skills for Copilot
upgrade agent-config to the latest version
why does this plugin contain only one skill?
I want governed coding-agent rules and skills here, how do I get the full suite?
install eslint and prettier in this repo
add the GitHub MCP server to my Copilot config
write a new skill that reviews SQL migrations
fix the failing unit test in the auth service
rename this React component and update its imports
